name: YANG Catalog (deployment)
what_it_is: Docker Compose-based deployment of the YANG Catalog platform, a centralized repository that aggregates YANG configuration models with validation services, module search, and a web UI. Provides both development and production deployment modes including optional Kubernetes and OpenShift targets.
measurement: All logs stored in /var/yang/logs (configurable via yangcatalog.conf)
Admin UI provides log filtering and review
CRON_MAIL_TO for cron failure email alerts
configuration: REDIS_VOLUME, OPENSEARCH_DATA, OPENSEARCH_LOG, NGINX_LOG, CONFD_LOG (storage paths)
modes: Local development: Docker Compose with containerized OpenSearch
Kubernetes: alternative deployment via k8s guide
OpenShift: multi-tenant Kubernetes variant with non-root constraints
constraints: ConfD (Tail-F proprietary software) is required but cannot be freely distributed — must be separately acquired
Development environment requires at least 10 GB RAM and 45 GB module data capacity
Production environment requires 24 GB RAM and 250 GB data capacity
IPv4 required for Docker Hub connectivity
Shared volume at /var/yang required for inter-container data access
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos testing mechanisms documented
No backup or disaster recovery procedures
